fact: 84% of U.S. adults use YouTube — more than any other platform.

fact: 71% of U.S. adults use Facebook, rising to 80% of adults aged 30–49.

fact: Half of U.S. adults use Instagram, including 80% of adults aged 18–29 (vs 19% of those 65+).
source: Pew Research Center, Americans' Social Media Use 2025

fact: 37% of U.S. adults use TikTok, and roughly half of 18–29 year olds use it every day.
source: Pew Research Center, Americans' Social Media Use 2025

fact: About half of U.S. adults visit Facebook and YouTube at least once a day.

fact: 73% of consumers say they'll buy from a competitor if a brand doesn't respond on social media.
A third of consumers think it's embarrassing when brands jump on viral trends.
About half of consumers say original content is what makes their favourite brands stand out on social.
For buying directly on social, TikTok is the top platform for Gen Z (54%) and Millennials (47%); Facebook leads across all consumers (39%).
There are 5.66 billion social media user identities worldwide — 68.7% of the global population.
Including video platforms like YouTube and TikTok, online adults spend well over 2½ hours a day on social media.
source: DataReportal, Digital 2026 Global Overview Report (GWI data)

fact: Online adults use about 6.75 different social platforms each month, so the same people can be reached in several places.
source: DataReportal, Digital 2026 Global Overview Report (GWI data)

fact: More than 30% of adult internet users discover new brands through ads on social platforms.
source: DataReportal, Digital 2026 Global Overview Report (GWI data)

fact: India has 500 million social media user identities — 34.1% of its population, so there is still large room to grow.
